title: berth deploy payload (v1)
description: The HMAC-signed JSON body a vessel POSTs to the berth runner. Owned by jlopez/berth-action; vendor a pinned copy host-side and validate inbound payloads against it before acting.

v.description: Contract version. Fixed by berth-notify; a future shape bumps this so the runner can branch on it. Unknown future keys are allowed (additionalProperties), so adding fields stays backward-compatible.

repo.description: owner/name, exactly one slash. The runner still matches this against its allowlist — this only gates shape.

ref.description: Commit SHA to check out deploy/compose.yml from.

instance.description: main, or pr-<n> for a preview.

host_prefix.description: DNS-safe Caddy subdomain prefix, always ending in '-' (e.g. gubs- or gubs-pr-8-). Flows into hostnames, so it is constrained to lowercase DNS label chars.

tag.description: Image tag the vessel CI pushed: main or pr-<n>.

action.description: up to deploy, down to tear down. (skip never reaches the runner.)

secrets.description: KEY=value pairs written host-side to the stack env file. Keys must be valid env-var identifiers; may be empty ({}).
